title: AI Rumpelstiltskin "Tip Toein' In My Jordans"
key_facts: An AI-generated video of Rumpelstiltskin dancing for a woman in a barn, styled like an 1980s fantasy film, was posted on 27 Aug 2026 by Instagram pages Stroinaya, Neuroferma and Anna Glinskaya.
In late September 2026 the clip was paired with the Riff Raff song "TIP TOE WING IN MY JAWWDINZ" and became a meme on TikTok and X.
A TikTok meme post of 29 Sep gained over 850,000 views in a week.
An X post of 1 Oct gained over 11,000 likes and 9.8 million views in five days.
People swap Rumpelstiltskin for other figures using AI video tools.
Some believed it came from an old Russian film or the 1987 Rumpelstiltskin movie; the site says the clip is confirmed to be AI.
quote_evidence: The clip is confirmed to be AI.
On October 1st, 2026, X[3] user @itsjusttimbro posted the clip of Rumplestiltskin dancing to "Tip Toe Wing In My Jawwdinz," garnering over 11,000 likes and 9.8 million views in five days.
why_it_matters_hint: A realistic AI-made clip fooled some viewers into thinking it was an old film.
event_date: Original clip 27 Aug 2026; meme spread late Sep to early Oct 2026.
notes: Know Your Meme is a community-written reference site. Underlying event (clip) is older than 8 Oct 2026, so score lowered by 1.
